articles.summary: Origin Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: OBK) (“Origin,” “we,” “our” or the “Company”), the holding company for Origin Bank (the “Bank”), today announced net income of $33.8 million, or $1.09 diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared to net income of $27.7 million, or $0.89 diluted EPS, for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. Pre-tax, pre-provision (“PTPP”)(1) earnings were $43.2 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared to $40.2 million for the linked quarter.

articles.summary: Origin Bank continues to expand its Southeast market presence with the opening of its first banking center in Fairhope, Alabama. Located at 508 Fairhope Avenue, the banking center will serve as a temporary location while the bank seeks a permanent location within the community.
articles.title: Origin Bank Continues Southeast Market Expansion | Origin Bank

articles.summary: Origin Bank has announced six new hires and five promotions across its North Texas market, continuing to strengthen its presence and commitment to serving clients in the region.
articles.title: Origin Bank Hires Six, Promotes Five Across | Origin Bank

articles.summary: Origin Bank today announced it has hired three banking professionals to join its team in North Texas. The addition of John Klein, Caroline Merritt and Mark H. Reily further strengthens Origin's ability to deliver excellent service, build relationships and meet the ever-changing financial needs of its customers.

articles.summary: Origin Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: OBK) ("Origin"), the holding company for Origin Bank, today announced that on July 22, 2026, its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share of its common stock.
